meta.name: Maniacs of the Truth
meta.description: This two-part documentary series explores Hungary’s most notorious and high-profile criminal cases following the fall of communism through the regular dinner gatherings of a unique group of friends - including retired detective Ernő Tóth and his former colleagues.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Detective Kovács revisits the disappearance of teenager Helga Farkas, probing the identity of her suspected kidnappers.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Investigators retrace the Magda Marinko murders, revealing how one of Hungary's most feared killers was caught.
